_comment: Neighbourhoods each branch serves. Single source for the React app (src/data/serviceAreas.ts) and the crawler renderer (public/prerender.php, public/sitemap.php). 'home' marks the branch's own location: its chip links to the branch page instead of an area page. 'route' finishes the sentence 'From <name>, ...'. 'alsoNear' names a second branch that is also convenient.
